name: zcode-statusbar
description: ZCode composer status bar: visual tok/s speed ramp, cumulative tokens, cache hit and subagent state under the input box, plus a color-ramp enhancement for the official context ring. Auto-installs via app.asar injection whenever the client is not injected (always on; a remove/uninstall writes an opt-out marker; modifies app.asar - fully quit and reopen ZCode to take effect). No per-answer text lines, no prompt-submit context injection, no cost/quota features, no network except the Release updater.
